intro.summary: West-end community of mostly 1950s single-detached homes west of 37 Street SW, near the 45 Street CTrain station.
intro.body: Glendale lies west of 37 Street SW and south of 17 Avenue SW, with the 45 Street CTrain station on its northern edge. It is almost entirely single-detached housing, largely 1950s bungalows on wide lots. Those lots draw new single-detached homes and, increasingly, semi-detached infill.
